findings.title: _append_xla_flag substring key-match can false-positive skip; redundant literal check
findings.detail: Idempotency check is `flag_key in flags` (plain substring). If a user's existing XLA_FLAGS merely CONTAINS the key as a substring of a different flag (e.g. '--xla_gpu_cuda_data_dir_custom'), our canonical flag would be skipped. Also `flag in flags` is redundant since flag_key is always a prefix of flag. Practical risk negligible (keys are long and unusual); suggest token-aware matching if XLA_FLAGS ever grows more flags. Non-blocking.

findings.title: config.is_t4_runtime broad except silently degrades to env-only detection in circular-import window
findings.detail: config.is_t4_runtime lazily imports gpu_fuzzy_trader._gpu_runtime.is_t4_runtime inside try/except Exception with env-var fallback. If any future module starts importing _gpu_runtime BEFORE config finishes initializing, the deferred import raises ImportError (partial module), the except swallows it, and hardware defaults would be silently skipped on a real T4. Audited current graph: safe today — every production importer imports config first (scripts/benchmark_t4.py:25-26, tests/benchmark/test_phase2_gpu_throughput.py:15-22) or defers _gpu_runtime into function bodies (phases/phase2_rule_pool.py:3337, backtest/gpu_engine.py:980); only tests/unit/test_t4_profile.py:11 imports _gpu_runtime first, where fallback False is correct on the non-T4 dev host. Recommend adding a comment documenting this import-order constraint. Non-blocking.

findings.title: Carry-over of task-1 F-3: T4 heuristics now gate behavior but remain loose (T400/T600 name match; 14.5-16.5 GiB window matches named non-T4 16GiB cards)
findings.detail: task-2 gates PHASE2_GPU_CPU_ROUTE_LARGE_DATA=False and SCAN_UNROLL<=16 on is_t4_runtime(), but detection was not tightened per task-1 review recommendation: 't4' substring matches small-VRAM workstation cards (T400/T600/T1000) and the VRAM fallback applies even when a non-T4 name is present. Mitigations keep risk low: VRAM tiers independently bound batch (a 4 GiB T400 resolves batch=min(cfg,64)), preallocate=false bounds VRAM growth, and misapplied defaults are conservative GPU-first settings appropriate for most 16 GiB cards. Task-2 STOP condition (no trigger on 8-core+RTX4050) verified satisfied. Suggest tightening (require vram>=14 when name matched, or exact-name regex '\bT4\b') in task-3/reconcile. Non-blocking.
